column1: # The owner's spots for the Sponge (758) and the Rattle (759), chosen in the spawn editor (2026-10-24): one row a container of an anomaly core of a map (the project folder); `from` the core's own kinds, `pos` where the container is (x y z, as the Maps tab draws it). srp-026g/scripts/sponge/spots.py makes the edit list artefact-spots-<n>.json of it.
